senses.gloss: m. (שְׁרַק III, cmp. יְרַקְרֵיקָא; popular etymol. fr. שְׁרַק I, q. v.) name of an unclean bird, gier-eagle or vulture.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 63a:10">Ḥull. 63ᵃ</cite> (Ms. R. 2 a. 3 <cite ref="U01986"><he>שְׁרִיקְרִיק</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30), v. <cite ref="T00518"><he>רָחָם</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 537:11">Yalk. Lev. 537</cite> <cite ref="U02026"><he>שרקריק</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: sh’raḳraḳ, the sound produced by the bird sh’raḳraḳ. Ḥull. l. c. ועביד ש׳ (Ms. M. שריקריק; Ar. ושריק רקרק); Yalk. l. c. ועביד שרקריק.
